title: Which local government area the pertussis response team goes to this week, off a line list whose areas reach the unit through laboratories of different speed
subdomain: disease surveillance and outbreak anomaly detection (a regional public health unit's pertussis notifications across inland New South Wales)
prompt_shape: 17 (periods around a change point): each area's 14-day count against its expected count, plus the school clusters and a ten-area quarterly table of five measures

sources.origin: constructed for this task by task181/generator/build.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional public health unit (Southern Inland Public Health Unit), a fictional private pathology network (Inland Pathology) and fictional schools, with real New South Wales local government areas, postcodes, public holidays and ICD-10-AM codes; no real person, case, school or laboratory result is depicted.
